lead: `DECLARATION_WINDOW` is 8 lines counted from the `Fault::` line, not from the guard's first line, so a nine-line comment sits silently outside it.
body: `conformance_coverage.rs` slices the eight lines above the `Fault::` call, so a `Fault::thrown(format!(` two lines below its `let` leaves seven for the comment, and a doc comment on the enclosing `fn` is outside once the body does anything before the guard. Put the declaration in the body immediately above the `let`, within seven lines — the failure reads as the phrase missing when it was one line too high.
